title: Andy Burnham praises UK-EU ties in meeting with Emmanuel Macron
description: The pair discussed small boats, defence and Ukraine in Burnham's first bilateral talks in Downing Street.

title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
description: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

title: Watch: BBC witnesses 'taxi boat' picking up migrants multiple times in a day
description: A BBC investigation has found smuggling gangs are running low on small boats, forcing rival gangs to work together and load more migrants on larger boats.

title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
description: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

title: Four to face trial accused of murdering baby
description: The four Slovakian nationals will stand trial at Sheffield Crown Court in April, a judge rules.

title: Zack Polanski says he'll run for former PM Starmer's seat in by-election
description: The Green Party leader intends to run in the Holborn and St Pancras seat following Sir Keir Starmer's resignation as MP.

title: Badenoch accuses Burnham of kicking defence spending into the long grass
description: Andy Burnham has committed to reaching the Nato target of 3.5% spending by 2035, but not 3% by 2030.

title: Households warned gas price spike could pile fresh pressure on energy bills
description: Experts warn low storage levels could push up gas prices further, leaving households with higher bills.
